workflow.description: An animated pet from a description or a picture, drawn by your own Codex: one picture of the pet first, then one strip of poses per state drawn from it, cut into equal cells and laid out as one sprite sheet, with a preview of each state. With the default states, the sheet and its pet.json are a pet the Codex app loads.
